pieces.Text: As a standard action, a haan can create a 30-foot cone of flame that deals 1d6 fire. Starting at 3rd level, a haan adds 1-1/2 x her character level to the damage. A creature in the cone can attempt a Reflex save (DC = 10 + half the haan's character level + her Constitution modifier) for half damage. A haan can't use this ability again until she has taken a 10-minute rest to recover Stamina Points.
